key_concepts: Natural things come from nature and are not made by people.
Human-made things are made by people, often using tools.
Soil, rocks, plants, animals, the Sun, and clouds are natural things.
Chairs, chalk, plastic bottles, tables, and cars are human-made things.
Animals and plants are living things found in nature.
Non-living things do not need food and water.
Rocks, clouds, the Sun, and plastic bottles are non-living things.
Some natural things, such as rocks, clouds, and the Sun, are also non-living.
Non-living things can be described by color, shape, texture, and hardness.
It is not safe to look directly at the Sun.
